results.name: Lodestones debut in Level 8 wave 3 with their hint, and come back in L8 W8 and W9
The iron turns a seed away (a guard, no refund); only the moss opens it, one tuft a hit
Its field curls a seed passing on the needle side onto the moss; the speed never changes and it never circles
A curled seed that blooms it wins a little sun ("Magnet curl!"); its last tug blooms up to four loose gems as the seed's chains
A credited chain or a power lands from any side (no guard, no curl); an uncredited strike opens it with no tug
The needle sways on the foe clock and a Lullaby holds it (and the fall); the field still bends seeds
A curling shot plays out the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
The aim line and the bot bend through the same field as the seed (one pure pull)
The bot shoots only the moss, and more for the last tuft when gems are near
foes.js keeps the Lodestone free of the seed pod and of Math.random
